RegistrationInfo.Description: DesktopShare files/windowsdesktop-kube-autostart.xml: 1 min after sign-in, open Windows Terminal running WSL files/windowsdesktop-kube-boot.sh (wait for Docker Desktop, minikube start, settle 5 min, zellij --layout kube-service-ports-efm). Re-register from WSL (schtasks only reads UTF-16): sed 's/encoding="UTF-8"/encoding="UTF-16"/' files/windowsdesktop-kube-autostart.xml | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16 > /mnt/c/temp/kube-autostart.xml; schtasks.exe /create /tn WindowsDesktop-Kube-AutoStart /xml C:\temp\kube-autostart.xml /f

Exec.Arguments: -w kube new-tab --title kube-service-ports-efm wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -u tunas --cd ~ -- bash -lc /home/tunas/DesktopShare/files/windowsdesktop-kube-boot.sh
